Size is single-select; it replaces the base price. Add-ons are added separately and retained in the order payload.
Code paths reviewed, but wallet booking payment must be tested through payment, escrow and booking confirmation.
Home and Pay share wallet cache with refresh and invalidation handling.
Download action exists; confirm it downloads and opens a quotation on iOS and Android.
Saved cards work for quotation payment but not direct service or room reservation checkout.
Save-card option is explicit and off by default where saved-card payment is implemented.
Confirm Upcoming, Active, Past and Cancelled segments fit and scroll correctly on small screens.
Only the category platform fee should apply to orders. Verify displayed and charged totals against admin fee settings.
Confirm a successful card payment appears once in transaction history with the correct amount and status.
Merchant cancellation refunds first. A terminal cancellation is not persisted if refund processing fails.
Home and Pay wallet balance mismatch
Both views read the shared wallet query and receive refresh/invalidation updates.
Test a fresh unpaid order with a valid points balance and verify the discount and payment total.
Requires production checks for SPF, DKIM, DMARC and sending-provider reputation; cannot be confirmed by application code alone.
Google account verification is outside the codebase and must be completed in Play Console.
Verify category and subcategory labels with current production taxonomy data.
24/7 availability is supported during onboarding and settings, and displays correctly to customers.
Back navigation uses history first and avoids forced routing to Home.
Admin can add or remove a live business from What’s Hot. City-scoped featured businesses and advertisers remain included.
Caching and deferred home loading are in place. Capture cold-start and home-ready timing on production-like networks.
Ruby+ Select posts link to profile
Open image and video posts and verify linked business posts route to the correct profile.
Transcoding code exists. Verify upload processing, playback startup, buffering, image fallback and mobile data usage.
Create a branch and confirm its approval path matches the agreed business rules without unintended admin gating.
Prompt caching, location reuse, short response limits and latency logging exist. Measure real response latency before sign-off.
